standard.title: Paragraph structure, cohesion and image integration
standard.description: understand how paragraph structure can be varied to create cohesion, and paragraphs and images can be integrated for different purposes
standard.prior_knowledge: Students investigate cohesive devices including nominalisation and text connectives (AC9E9LA04). They have not yet analysed how paragraph structure can be varied to create cohesion or how paragraphs and images integrate for different purposes.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students understand how paragraph structure can be varied to create cohesion, and how paragraphs and images can be integrated for different purposes.

nodes.label: Varying paragraph structure for effect
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can identify how authors vary paragraph structures and explain the cohesive or rhetorical effect of those variations.
nodes.minimum_width: Identify at least one example of varied paragraph structure in a text (e.g. short single-sentence paragraph, delayed topic sentence) and explain the effect.
nodes.typical_width: Examine how authors vary paragraph structures for rhetorical or cohesive effect across a range of text types, explaining what each variation achieves.
wider: Compare paragraph structure variations in literary and non-literary texts, analysing how variation serves different purposes in each
Examine how digital and online texts use unconventional paragraph structures to aid navigation and engagement
Analyse how First Nations Australian authors vary paragraph structure to incorporate oral storytelling rhythms
success_criteria: Identifies a specific paragraph structure variation in a text
Explains the cohesive or rhetorical effect of the variation

nodes.label: Integrating paragraphs and images for purpose
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can understand how paragraphs and images are integrated in texts, and explain how integration serves different purposes for different audiences.
nodes.minimum_width: Identify how a paragraph and image are integrated in a provided text and explain the purpose of that integration.
nodes.typical_width: Examine the integration of paragraphs and images across different multimodal texts (websites, graphic novels), explaining how different integration strategies serve different purposes and audiences.
wider: Compare image-text integration in graphic novels versus news websites, evaluating how the relationship between modes creates meaning differently in each
Examine how the placement and relationship of paragraphs and images on a webpage guides reader attention and serves a navigational or persuasive purpose
Analyse how First Nations Australian visual artists integrate text and image in community or activist publications

response_modes.reason: Image-text integration operates very differently across text types — the relationship in a graphic novel is fundamentally different from a webpage or infographic; students need multiple contexts to understand the range of integration strategies.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Image-paragraph integration spans a rich range of digital, print and visual text types — comparative work across graphic novels, websites and activist publications offers genuine width in understanding multimodal meaning-making.
success_criteria: Identifies how paragraphs and images are integrated in a specific text
Explains the purpose the integration serves for the intended audience
